seo.title: Demo: a real coaching session with Cairnly
seo.description: Scroll through a complete coaching session of a fictional candidate: where she pushes back, what the coach does with it, and how her report changes. Real AI output, no script.

marloes.tagline: Marloes, 41, customer service team lead at an insurer. Done managing a team, wants to be closer to the people she helps.

intro.title: A real coaching session, start to finish
intro.body: This is the conversation as Marloes had it: the report arrives chapter by chapter, she reacts, the coach reacts back. Nothing was polished afterwards. Watch for three moments along the way:
watch: Where she pushes back on her personality analysis, and the coach takes it on board.
Where she keeps an answer, so it goes into her report word for word.
The comparison between her top careers, drawn from her own scores.
intro.howTo: Click the cards to open them, hover over the radar. You cannot type here: this is a replay.

fallback.dutchOnly: This demo is in Dutch: Marloes is a Dutch candidate. An English session is coming. The buttons and labels follow your language, the conversation stays Dutch.

pushback.title: She disagrees
pushback.body: Marloes clicks 'I see this differently' and says exactly where the analysis goes too far. No form, no star rating: pushback in her own words.

kept.title: The coach takes it on board, and she keeps it
kept.body: The coach corrects the analysis on the spot. Marloes presses Keep and this answer goes into her final report word for word. That is how the report becomes hers, not just about her.

radar.title: Three careers, five axes, no template
radar.body: This radar is drawn from her own scores. Hover over a name to see that career on its own, and click 'Explain this comparison' to read what the difference means for her.

highlights.title: What this conversation changed in her report
highlights.body: At wrap-up the coach summarises the session. These points now sit in her report, next to the answers she kept along the way.

footer.body: Marloes does not exist. Her survey answers were written by us. Everything the coach says and everything in her report is real, unedited Cairnly output.
